scope: Explicit user authorization: exploratory morphology factors and offline classification only; no economic-return labels or production gates changed
prior_exposure: v1 year-end 2020-2022 forward persistence summaries were already inspected. 2022-2023 are chronological development validation, not untouched final holdout. This study cannot certify a final factor.
snapshots: Last trading session of each calendar quarter 2020Q1 through 2023Q4; last 504 market sessions; all predictor calculations use information through signal close
broad_pool: Keep v1 data quality, liquidity, structural checks, 10%-40% robust box width, full extreme close range <=60%, current close in robust box. Require >=2 alternating quote-supported traversals full window and >=1 each half. Do not require v1 center/boundary/trend thresholds, six traversals or frozen-half confirmation: these become predictors. Separate strict v1 subset retained.
price_and_event_semantics: Unadjusted nominal quote morphology, quote-change chain not total return; event date/type diagnostics are retrospective quality checks. Future structural events and low quote coverage are UNKNOWN for shape, never filter predictor pool. No use of subsequent ST/delisting status to remove samples.
label_range_persistence: v1 fixed full-window band: future active quote coverage >=95%, valid close containment >=80%, no >=10-session run outside [0.99L,1.01U]
primary_label: range_persistence AND at least two quote-supported alternating traversals during the 126 future sessions, using the same fixed historical box/zones and v1 minimum spacing/quote-movement requirements; future slice starts at t+1. Future structural event => unknown, low quote coverage => unknown, horizon past cutoff => immature. Unknown retained in full inventory but excluded from supervised fit; conservative hit rate keeps them in screening denominator.
secondary_label: range_persistence only; diagnostic, not used to retune this version

feature_quality: At least 90% valid observations for each recent return/amount window; consecutive-only lag and 5-day sequences; NaNs retained and imputed from training only. Correlation matrix reported; no causal interpretation of coefficients/importances.
training_discovery: Quarterly signal rows whose full future label ends strictly before 2022-01-01; no random split
fold_train: For each validation calendar year, use only signals and labels completely matured strictly before Jan1 of that year. No model refit inside validation year. Unknown labels not negatives. No future predictors in fit, scaling or clipping.
fold_validation: All quarter-end signals in that year whose 126-session horizon matures by 2023 end. Hence four 2022 quarters and two 2023 quarters, calendar verified rather than assumed
weights: Each signal date equal total weight within train/validation; report raw stock-date and unique-stock counts. Quarterly observations overlap across adjacent dates and repeat stocks; they are not independent trials.
single_factor: Predetermined directions, top ceil(n/3) per signal date. All sixteen reported. For width-adjusted analysis, select top ceil(n/3) separately inside each signal date's rank-based box-width terciles; box_width itself has no width-adjusted result. Selection includes future-unknown samples and reports conservative success/selected alongside known-label rate. Feature NaN ranks bottom; symbol resolves ties. No parameter sweep.

models.preprocessing: Train-only median imputation, train-only [1%,99%] winsorization and StandardScaler; drop train entirely-missing columns only
baselines: v1 historical shape_score for ranking only
metrics: equal-date AUC and average precision on known labels
Brier versus training prior and width-only probability baselines
top-third conservative hit and lift versus equal-date pool

uncertainty: Descriptive 95% percentile bootstrap, 1000 draws, seed26027, resample stock clusters and 2-adjacent-quarter circular date blocks with crossed multiplicity weights; retain stock trajectories and adjacent-date dependence approximately. Very few independent time blocks; intervals unadjusted for16 trials and cannot prove significance. Report all16, do not call highest observed uplift validated.
tentative_factor_gate: Discovery equal-date conservative lift >0; positive width-adjusted lift in both2022 and2023 (box_width excluded as mechanical comparator); pooled selected observations>=30, selected unique stocks>=20, selected successes>=5. Label only cross-year directional lead, not statistically confirmed factor; bootstrap shown separately. Never promote solely by pooled ranking.
model_gate: Model top-third lift>0 AND Brier<prior AND Brier<width-only in BOTH2022 and2023; otherwise no ranking of old20by that model. Even gate pass remains development-only; no2024audit in this task.
